Build the collecting team of each plot

dot-build_openforis_collector_team.Rd

Merges the team_leader and additional_people values decoded from plot.xlsx into a single comma-separated list of people, dropping anyone named in both. Fed to the additional_collector column of the specimen table.

Usage

.build_openforis_collector_team(plots)

Arguments

plots

Plot table produced by .prepare_openforis_new_plots().

Value

Data frame with columns plot_name and additional_collector, or NULL when neither people column exists.
